summary: Trafo is a family business in Wolvega, Netherlands, that makes organic potato crisps and other snacks from vegetables, maize and pulses. Its potato crisps are fried in sunflower, coconut or olive oil, using potatoes from the Flevopolder. The company says it has worked with local farmers since 1983.
products: Classic organic potato crisps fried in sunflower oil
Potato crisps fried in coconut oil or olive oil
Vegetable crisps (carrot, red beetroot, parsnip, sweet potato)
Legume and protein chips from pulses, chickpeas and lentils
Pea, chickpea and lentil flips; oven-baked corn flips
Tortilla chips, popcorn, pretzel sticks and children's snacks
markets: Netherlands: Ekoplaza, Odin shops, independent health food shops
Germany: SuperBiomarkt, Alnatura, Biocompany, Denns biomarkets
United Kingdom: Planet Organic, Superfood Market
Health food and organic specialty stores
facts: Has made crisps for more than 30 years
Has worked with local farmers since 1983
Classic crisps sold in 12 x 125 g cases
